Shipped — v2.0.0 “Atlas” (July 2026) #

  • Complete cosmic UI rebuild: 14 tabs, mascot hub, orb navigation, mobile-first responsive.
  • Curriculum lenses: CAPS, IEB, Cambridge A-Levels, Global — Grade 1 to post-matric with no ceiling.
  • Mastery engine: five dimensions, four bands, spaced repetition, XP/badges, Data Desk analytics.
  • Mathaloid Brain v2: step-by-step linear & quadratic solvers, polynomial calculus, fractions/percentages/number theory, 18+ concept explainers, adaptive quizzes — 100% on-device.
  • Documentation system: Markdown-canonical guides with generated HTML/JSON counterparts, themed portal, docs:build / docs:check pipeline (Lehro house pattern).

Next horizons #

PriorityItemNotes
P1More games per bandTarget: every skill category has ≥2 game formats
P1Printable worksheet generatorClient-side print stylesheets; still zero-server
P2PWA install + full offline cacheService worker; keeps the zero-request promise
P2i18n scaffoldingAfrikaans + isiZulu first; lens-aware terminology
P2Teacher modeLocal class lists via import/export codes — no accounts
P3A-Level depth packVectors, mechanics applications, further calculus
P3Opt-in local small-model experimentOnly if it runs fully on-device and degrades gracefully; deterministic brain stays the default
P3Accessibility audit round 2Screen-reader passes on all games

Non-goals (permanent) #

  • Accounts, cloud sync, telemetry, ads, or any server dependency.
  • Paid tiers — the tool is MIT and free forever.
